[Made with love by Vercel](https://vercel.com/ "Made with love by Vercel")[zero-native](https://zero-native.dev/) Search docs `⌘K` [4.1k](https://github.com/vercel-labs/zero-native) Quick Start Getting Started [Introduction](https://zero-native.dev/) [Quick Start](https://zero-native.dev/quick-start) [App Model](https://zero-native.dev/app-model) [Frontend Projects](https://zero-native.dev/frontend) Core Concepts [Web Engines](https://zero-native.dev/web-engines) [Windows](https://zero-native.dev/windows) [Multiple WebViews](https://zero-native.dev/webviews) [Bridge](https://zero-native.dev/bridge) [Builtin Commands](https://zero-native.dev/bridge/builtin-commands) [Dialogs](https://zero-native.dev/dialogs) [System Tray](https://zero-native.dev/tray) [Security](https://zero-native.dev/security) Tooling [CLI Reference](https://zero-native.dev/cli) [Dev Server](https://zero-native.dev/cli/dev) [Packaging](https://zero-native.dev/packaging) [Code Signing](https://zero-native.dev/packaging/signing) [Updates](https://zero-native.dev/updates) [app.zon Reference](https://zero-native.dev/app-zon) Operations [Debugging](https://zero-native.dev/debugging) [zero-native doctor](https://zero-native.dev/debugging/doctor) [Automation](https://zero-native.dev/automation) [Testing](https://zero-native.dev/testing) Advanced [Extensions](https://zero-native.dev/extensions) [Embedded App](https://zero-native.dev/embed) [Package Distribution](https://zero-native.dev/packages) # Quick Start zero-native is a Zig desktop app shell with selectable web engines. Use the system WebView (WKWebView, WebKitGTK) for lightweight apps, or bundle Chromium via CEF on macOS for predictable Chromium rendering. Create a native desktop app with a web UI in under a minute. ## Beta scope The current beta target is macOS desktop apps. System WebView builds are available on macOS and Linux, Chromium/CEF builds and packages are macOS-only, and Windows plus Linux Chromium support are on the roadmap. ## Prerequisites - [Zig 0.16.0+](https://ziglang.org/download/) - Node.js with npm for the generated frontend - macOS 11 or newer, or Linux (Windows support is in progress) ## Create a project ``` zero-native init my_app --frontend next cd my_app ``` Frontend options: `next`, `vite`, `react`, `svelte`, `vue`. This scaffolds a complete zero-native project: | File | Purpose | | --- | --- | | `build.zig` | Zig build graph with platform, trace, debug-overlay, automation, js-bridge, and web-engine options | | `build.zig.zon` | Zig package manifest, declares zero-native dependency | | `app.zon` | App metadata: name, icons, permissions, bridge commands, security policy, window definitions | | `src/main.zig` | App struct with `app()` and optional `bridge()` methods | | `src/runner.zig` | Platform wiring: trace sinks, file logging, panic capture, state store, runtime init | | `assets/icon.icns` | App icon for macOS packages | | `frontend/` | Frontend starter for the framework selected with `--frontend` | ## Run it ``` zig build run ``` The first frontend build installs dependencies automatically. Your app opens a native window with a WebView rendering your HTML. ## macOS beta path Use this path when validating an app for the macOS beta: ``` zero-native init my_app --frontend next cd my_app zig build run zero-native cef install zig build run zero-native package --target macos --signing identity --identity "Developer ID Application: Your Name" zero-native doctor --manifest app.zon --strict ``` Set `.web_engine = "chromium"` and `.cef = .{ .dir = "third_party/cef/macos", .auto_install = false }` in `app.zon` before the Chromium run. `-Dweb-engine` and `--web-engine` are still available for one-off overrides, but the normal app workflow reads the manifest. For frontend frameworks, run the frontend dev server through [Dev Server](https://zero-native.dev/cli/dev) during development, then package the built assets for distribution. ## Hello world The simplest zero-native app provides a name and inline HTML: ``` const HelloApp = struct { fn app(self: *@This()) zero_native.App { return .{ .context = self, .name = "hello", .source = zero_native.WebViewSource.html( \\ \\ \\ \\

Hello from zero-native

\\ \\ ), }; } }; ``` ## Next steps - [Web Engines](https://zero-native.dev/web-engines) \-\- Choose between system WebView and Chromium (CEF) - [App Model](https://zero-native.dev/app-model) \-\- How apps, sources, and lifecycle callbacks work - [Frontend Projects](https://zero-native.dev/frontend) \-\- Use React, Vue, or Svelte with zero-native - [Bridge](https://zero-native.dev/bridge) \-\- Call native Zig code from JavaScript - [Security](https://zero-native.dev/security) \-\- Permissions, policies, and navigation rules
